title: Ranges
statement: The task is to find the minimum number of directly queried intervals so that all m required intervals are concatenations of queried ones, re-answered after each of q replacements (n, m, q ≤ 2·10^5). With cut points l-1 and r as graph vertices and each required interval an edge, the answer is distinct endpoints minus connected components, maintained by offline dynamic connectivity: rollback DSU over a segment tree on time.
